Windows to Omarchy: gaming

Gaming after Windows

Every launcher is one menu away. Here is what works where.

Reviewed 2026-10-19 · independent editorial guide

Short answer

Most of your library comes along. On Omarchy, open Install > Gaming to add Steam, Battle.net, Heroic for Epic, GOG and Amazon, Lutris for EA and Ubisoft, Minecraft, Xbox Cloud Gaming and GeForce NOW. Games that need anti-cheat, like Fortnite, can be played through cloud gaming or streamed from a Windows PC with Moonlight.

On this page Store mapOne libraryKeep your PCQuestionsSources

Where each Windows launcher goes

On Windows you usedOn Omarchy useNotes from the manual
SteamInstall > Gaming > SteamProton runs tens of thousands of Windows games. Steam can take 10 to 20 seconds to start with no visual feedback.
Battle.netInstall > Gaming > Battle.netDiablo, StarCraft and World of Warcraft run under GE-Proton, no Steam needed
Epic, GOG, AmazonInstall > Gaming > Heroic (Epic Games)Only Epic games that do not rely on anti-cheat, so no Fortnite or Rocket League
EA app, Ubisoft ConnectInstall > Gaming > LutrisInstalls can look stalled. Give them time.
Xbox Game PassInstall > Gaming > Xbox Cloud GamingWeb app, runs at 1080p, includes titles that do not run natively
GeForce NOWInstall > Gaming > NVIDIA GeForce NOWCloud play for titles not available on Linux
MinecraftInstall > Gaming > MinecraftFirst start can be slow with no feedback
EmulatorsInstall > Gaming > RetroArchPreconfigured with the CRT Royale shader. ROMs go in ~/Games/roms.

Put every launcher in one place

Omakade is a game library for Omarchy that gathers what you have installed across Steam, Lutris, Heroic, RetroArch, Battle.net and more into one cover-art view. Heroic has its own page too, and the Minecraft Launcher page explains what you need to buy to play.

Screenshots: the omakade page on this store, the heroic-games-launcher-bin page on this store.

Keep the Windows PC as a game server

If a game will not run on Linux, you do not have to give it up. Omarchy preinstalls Moonlight, so you can stream from a Windows PC running Sunshine. The manual says that when both machines are wired, it feels like playing locally, and suggests native resolution, 120Hz and maximum bitrate. Pair Xbox controllers over Bluetooth after Install > Gaming > Xbox Controllers.

Frequently asked questions

Can I play Steam games on Omarchy?

Yes. Install Steam from Install > Gaming > Steam. Valve's Proton layer runs tens of thousands of Windows games on Linux.

Does Fortnite work on Omarchy?

Not natively. The manual suggests Xbox Cloud Gaming or GeForce NOW, or streaming from a Windows PC with Moonlight and Sunshine.

How do I play Epic Games Store games?

Install Heroic from Install > Gaming. It runs Epic titles that do not rely on anti-cheat, plus GOG and Amazon Prime Gaming games.

Do Xbox controllers work?

Yes. Add support with Install > Gaming > Xbox Controllers, then pair over Bluetooth with Super+Ctrl+B. Wired USB-C controllers need nothing extra.

Are NVIDIA drivers set up?

Yes. omarchy.org says NVIDIA drivers are set up during install.
